# Doit Then 1.0.21
- Improved Calendar and Reminders first-run permission handling. - Added recovery for incomplete or restricted permissions. - Refined the compact task-pane header. - Improved license-key entry with automatic focus and Return-to-activate. - Preserved existing planner, licensing, and Calendar behavior.
The permission changes passed local testing. Onboarding on the previously affected external Mac remains to be verified.
